title: PdfReorderRequestV1
description: One explicitly approved permutation of the structure-element kids of ONE parent element. The server resolves the reviewer's opaque node ids to `parentPath` / `orderedKidIndexes`; clients never send paths. The engine applies it to a copy, verifies every invariant and refuses anything ambiguous.

parentPath.description: kid indexes from the structure tree root to the parent whose kids are permuted; [] is the root itself

orderedKidIndexes.description: complete permutation of the parent's current kid indexes in the approved order
